query_template: Build a leveraged buyout model for {{target}}. Deal type: {{deal_type}}. Offer premium (public targets): {{offer_premium}}. Entry multiple or price override: {{entry_multiple}}. Hold period: {{hold_period}} years. Target leverage: {{leverage}}. Debt structure: {{debt_structure}}. Rollover equity: {{rollover_equity}}. Exit multiple assumption: {{exit_multiple}}. Reference documents: see the files attached to this turn. Additional context: {{context}}. Preferred data source: {{data_source}}. Output format: {{output_format}}.

pages.title: LBO model setup
pages.description: Transaction assumptions, operating model, multi-tranche debt schedule with cash sweep, covenant headroom, returns with attribution, and sensitivities are always included.

fields.label: Target company
fields.description: Public ticker/name for a take-private, or a private company name. Attach financials below for private targets.

options.label: Auto-detect
options.description: Public-to-private if the target trades publicly; private otherwise

options.label: Public-to-private
options.description: Offer premium on the current quoted price; fully diluted shares via treasury stock method

options.label: Private target
options.description: Entry multiple on user-provided or triangulated EBITDA with confidence flags

fields.label: Offer premium (public targets)
fields.description: Premium to the current share price. Default 30% if blank, stated as an assumption.

fields.label: Entry multiple or price (private targets / override)
fields.description: Entry EV/EBITDA or a fixed enterprise value. If blank for private targets, derived from peer trading multiples with an explicit note.

fields.label: Target leverage
fields.description: Total leverage in turns of LTM EBITDA, with tranche split if you have one. Default 5.0–5.5x if blank.

fields.label: Debt tranches
fields.description: Default if blank: revolver (undrawn) + TLB + senior notes. Rates built as base rate + spread from current market data.

options.value: Term Loan B (1% amortization, cash sweep)
options.label: Term Loan B (1% amortization, cash sweep)

fields.label: Rollover equity
fields.description: Management or seller equity rolled into the deal, tracked as a separate class through exit.

fields.label: Exit multiple
fields.description: Default: exit at the entry multiple. Any assumed expansion is flagged prominently in the returns story.

fields.label: Reference documents
fields.accept_description: CIM, databook, financial statements, prior models, lender presentations, or other reference material — primary source for private targets

fields.label: Additional context
fields.placeholder: e.g., Assume 300 bps EBITDA margin expansion by year 3, 75% cash sweep, covenant net leverage 6.0x with step-downs

fields.label: Data sources
fields.description: Select every data provider you want this run to draw on. Providers you have not connected are skipped gracefully and noted, so connecting them enriches the output. Perplexity Finance is always available.

options.label: Perplexity Finance (built-in)
options.description: Always available — live quotes, financials, estimates, transcripts, macro data

options.label: Daloopa
options.description: Analyst-grade historical fundamentals and KPIs with filing citations — requires connected Daloopa

options.label: FactSet
options.description: Consensus estimates, fundamentals, ownership, M&A — requires connected FactSet

options.label: Morningstar
options.description: Fundamentals, fair values, fund and ETF data — requires connected Morningstar

options.label: PitchBook
options.description: Private company rounds, valuations, cap tables, sponsor M&A — requires connected PitchBook
